blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings daily with no reservations required, featuring a choice of 4 different wines for $10. Wine tours are available by reservation only, at least 24 hours in advance, for guests 21 and older with no pets allowed. The winery also offers a private event space for functions such as birthdays, fundraisers, and corporate meetings, with rental fees and beverage minimums.
extraNote: No outside alcohol allowed on premises or at events · Private event rental fee is non-refundable, $400 minimum plus tax · Minimum beverage purchase of $300 required for private events · Renters responsible for damages, $200 fee or actual cost · Reservations for tours must be made at least 24 hours in advance
